summary: Combined focused Layer 1B searches: Layer 1B expansion for the grid-services/interconnection node identifies one reference leader and two underfollowed direct-exposure candidates. The node is service-heavy: high-voltage field labor, transmission/substation construction, engineering/design, utility coordination, testing/inspection, and commissioning can bottleneck grid expansion even when generation and electrical equipment are available. This pass avoids hyperscalers and equipment mega-caps and focuses on public companies whose reported services map directly to transmission, substation, utility design, EPC, inspection, and grid-reliability work. Layer 1B expanded the grid services/interconnection node into a two-lane universe. Quanta Services is the obvious reference leader for utility-scale electric-power engineering/construction/backlog context. MYR Group is the strongest underfollowed pure-play candidate because its Transmission & Distribution segment directly covers transmission, distribution, substation, clean-energy, design, engineering, procurement, construction, upgrade, maintenance and repair services, with multi-year MSAs and repeat utility relationships. Willdan is a second-order underfollowed hypothesis focused less on heavy field construction and more on utility programs, grid optimization, data-center power engineering, interconnection know-how, software/data analytics and planning services that could matter if the bottleneck is permitting/interconnection/process capacity rather than commodity equipment alone.
